name: Pop Star Calix
source:
Working for a editorial magazine, your boss assigns you the task of interviewing pop star Calix for a big article about his life after leaving the boyband. Will you be able to navigate the mountain of rumors and find the real information underneath?

[From the [url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/pop-star-calix/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你在一家社论杂志工作，老板指派你采访流行歌星卡利克斯，写一篇关于他离开男孩乐队后的生活的大文章。你能在谣言之山中穿行并找到其背后的真实信息吗？

[来自[url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/pop-star-calix/]官网[/url]]
